entries.75884c0eb192ab3e: The company states that it positions the medical equipment and healthcare-related fields as priority areas for the Electronic Circuit Board Business and works on technological development of high-density multilayer boards. It states that it will make FPC prototyping and small- and medium-lot mass production projects a pillar of its business, and will also advance the provision of electronics manufacturing services (EMS) covering everything consistently from circuit design to modularization and assembly of final products. In the Test System Business, it states that it positions the power device market, where growth is expected against the background of AI, EV and high-speed communications, as a priority growth field, and works to improve defect detection capability and inspection accuracy of inspection equipment for ceramic substrates and to expand sales channels through collaboration with sales agents.

entries.8d311631c16c0e41: This is a reportable segment that mainly manufactures and sells flexible printed circuit boards (FPCs). From circuit pattern design through drilling, plating, etching and final inspection, the company handles everything in-house except component mounting, responding to short-lead-time needs for prototypes and small-lot production. It also manufactures and sells electroformed products. Consolidated subsidiaries in Thailand and Shanghai handle product sales and service and support. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,409 million.
